title: education/exams
description: One row per scheduled examination sitting. Timetabled exams, each placed in a room at a time. Useful for testing scheduling features and room-clash detection, since the same room is used many times.

course_id.description: Which course is being examined. A course typically has a midterm and a final, sometimes a resit.

classroom_id.description: Where the exam takes place. Always a room at the same school as the course.

exam_date.description: Date of the sitting, always a weekday during term time and within the course's academic year.

exam_type.description: Which kind of sitting: a midterm, the final, a practice mock, or a resit for pupils who failed first time.

duration_minutes.description: How long pupils get, from 45 minutes for a short midterm to 180 for a Bachillerato final.

max_score.description: Marks available. Almost always 10, because the Spanish scale is 0 to 10, which makes the few exceptions worth handling.

registered_students.description: How many pupils were entered for this sitting, never more than the capacity of the room it was scheduled into.
